purpose: Record the shared display frame used by SVG, solar field, terrain texture, and city markers.

solarField.projectionChain: UTC -> WGS84 solar altitude -> LCC -> SpatialBridge -> SVG V
solarField.officialBodyCandidateMode: runtime raster gap-close + outside flood-fill from exact displayed linework; visual-only clipping
solarField.maskStatus: APPROXIMATE_VISUAL_MASK - SAME DISPLAY FRAME; NOT A GEOGRAPHIC SOURCE
solarField.maskDisclaimer: APPROXIMATE_VISUAL_MASK - SAME DISPLAY FRAME; NOT A GEOGRAPHIC SOURCE

changes: Moved the single presentation scale from map-image and south-sea-layer to their shared map-visual parent.
Canvas and marker positions now use offsetWidth/offsetHeight layout dimensions.
Land mask is derived at runtime from the exact presentation-coastline.svg linework in V space.
Same-source components retain the dominant mainland plus explicit Hainan/Taiwan anchors and remove isolated print loops.
Terminator rendering uses a separate 1x CSS-pixel mask guard before compositing.
Official SVG geometry and source assets remain unchanged.
